in_hindi.name: जितवंश
in_hindi.meaning: जित (Jit) - विजय (Vijay) + वंश (Vansh) - वंश (Vansh) - विजयी वंश (Vijayee Vansh) - Progeny of Victory

in_telugu.name: జిట్వంశ్
in_telugu.meaning: జిట్ (Jit) + వంశ్ (Vansh) - జీబ్రీ వంశ్ (Jibri Vansh) - Progeny of Victory

in_marathi.name: Jitvansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jitvansh is a Sanskrit name that is derived from 'Jit' meaning victory and 'Vansh' meaning lineage. It signifies a person who comes from a victorious lineage, someone who carries the legacy of triumph and success. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and holds great significance in the context of courage, strength, and legacy.
